falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 low invalidates the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom structure would be violated rather than held; the 'bottom' call requires that level to serve as support

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained panic-level volatility contradicts a bottoming formation with blowoff score of 40 (moderate, not capitulation); this would indicate ongoing liquidation rather than the exhaustion selling typical of pattern completion

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield falls below 3.80% and stays there for 5 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid this persistent signals macro deterioration (recession/financial stress) rather than the soft-landing/growth-scare resolution that the August 2024 bottom pattern implied; it would show the market pricing systemic risk, not a tradable low

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
